title: quirq-repo/1
description: A quirq infra repo manifest (infra/repo.toml): pinned toolchains, pinned dependencies and typed targets. Parsed, never executed. Unknown keys are rejected so a typo is an error, not a silently ignored setting.

schema.description: The schema version this manifest follows.

qq.description: The qq CLI version this repo runs. A fresh machine installs exactly this version.

toolchains.description: Toolchains the targets build with, by name. Names match the toolchain names in infra-config's kinds.toml.

deps.description: Other dependencies fetched before a build, by name.

targets.description: What this repo builds, tests and ships.

version.description: A human-readable version label. Informational: the digest is what is verified.

source.description: Where the pinned artifact is fetched from. Opaque to sync: the fetcher interprets the scheme.

digest.description: The content pin. sha256:<64 hex> for an artifact's bytes, git:<40 or 64 hex> for a commit.

pin.description: One pinned thing: either source and digest, or platforms with a source and digest each (not both).

kind.description: An opaque kind name from infra-config's kinds.toml; quirq-ai/recipes gives it meaning.

srcs.description: Input globs, relative to the repo root.

outs.description: Declared outputs, relative to the target's output root.

deps.description: Names of other targets in this manifest that this one needs first.

cacheable.description: false for a step that is not hermetic: it still runs but its result is never reused.

params.description: Kind-specific settings, passed to the kind's adapter as is. sync does not interpret them.
